beats.text: How much money does a normal American under thirty-five have in the bank?
The Federal Reserve checked their accounts: checking, savings, the lot.
Each bar is one tenth of them, from the smallest balance to the biggest.
The average: about twenty thousand dollars.
But the person in the middle has just five thousand four hundred. A few big accounts pull the average up.
So if your account looks small next to the average, compare it to the middle instead.

sources: Federal Reserve, Survey of Consumer Finances 2022 (via Experian, 'Average savings by age'): transaction accounts (checking, savings, money market, call accounts, prepaid cards) by age of family head – under 35: mean $20,540, median $5,400; 35–44: $41,540 / $7,500; 45–54: $71,130 / $8,700; 55–64: $72,520 / $8,000. Decile bars schematic, chosen so mean = 20.5k and median ≈ 5.4k.
